theorem_title: Packing all block masks into indexed coordinates
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockMasks.meets {pMain pPowers : ℕ}
    (hmain : P[pMain]? = some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockMasks.body pPowers)) (hPowers : P[pPowers]? = some _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.powTableBody)
    {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {J L src dst work d : ℕ} (rows : Fin J → Finset (Fin L))
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hsrc : src+J ≤ work) (hdst : dst+J ≤ work) (hsep : _root_.Light.Apart src J dst J)
    (hspace : work+(L+1) ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : ((2^(J*L+1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hread : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SegN μ src (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockMaskLayout.rawMasks rows)) (hd : d+1 ≤ lim.depth) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim P pMain d [J,L,src,dst,work] μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBlockMasks.time J L)
      (fun r μ' => r = (_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.subsetMask (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockIndex.indexSet (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockRows.flat rows)) : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SegN μ' dst (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockMaskLayout.packedMasks rows) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.KeptBut μ μ' work dst J) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $J$ stored width-$L$ row masks represent subsets $R_i$. Suppose source and destination arrays are disjoint before scratch, its $L+1$ power cells fit, $2^{JL+1}$ and addresses fit words, and the power helper and depth bound hold. The program writes every packed row mask and returns the mask of their flattened indexed-coordinate set, changing only the output and scratch within its stated time.

This packing contract links stored per-block row masks to the compact indexed coordinates used by reporting queries.
